client:
Genuine care... I don't know if I can even recognize it anymore. When people are nice to me, part of me just keeps waiting for the other shoe to drop, for them to ask for something or disappear when I really need them. 

The few times I've let myself believe it might be real, it feels like... like when someone remembers small details about me without me telling them twice. But then I start analyzing if they're just doing that to manipulate me. It's exhausting.
